visual.general_description: Two grayscale CT panels, A and B, showing a large heterogeneous stomach-shaped intraluminal mass with white arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Panels A and B are placed side by side inside a framed image, each with its letter printed in a white box at the upper left. Both show a large stomach-shaped structure filled with mottled heterogeneous material with dark pockets, marked with white arrows. Panel B carries partly legible scanner overlay text at the left edge.

panels.general_description: Grayscale CT image in a sagittal-style plane showing a large heterogeneous intraluminal mass with air-like dark pockets inside a stomach-shaped structure.
panels.detailed_description: Panel letter A is printed in a white box at the upper left. A large oval structure with a thin bright wall contains mottled heterogeneous material with dark gas-like pockets; its outline is stomach-shaped and it occupies much of the abdominal cavity. Three white arrows point to the wall or margin of the structure and to adjacent regions. Bright round bone profiles lie along the right edge and a bright structure appears at the lower center. Faint blurred smudges are present along the left edge and are not legible as text.

panels.detailed_description: Panel letter B is printed in a white box at the upper left. A round cross-section of the abdomen shows a vertebra with a bright posterior element at the lower center, and anteriorly a large stomach-shaped region filled with mottled heterogeneous material with some dark pockets, outlined by a thin wall. Three white arrows point to the wall or margin of this region and to adjacent bowel. Small lines of overlay text run down the left edge of the image, only partly legible; a fragment resembling a date and a line of text near the left arrow are visible but cannot be transcribed reliably.

visual.general_description: Operative photograph of a large dark hair-like mass being lifted out of an opened abdomen.
visual.detailed_description: A large dark brown fibrous mass with a tail-like extension is held in the opened operative field by gloved hands and an instrument, with green and white surgical drapes around it.

panels.general_description: Operative photograph of a large dark brown hair-like mass lifted from an opened abdomen with gloved hands and surgical drapes.
panels.detailed_description: A large, dark brown to black, rounded mass with a fibrous, hair-like texture lies at the center, with a narrower tail-like extension curving down toward the lower right where it is held by gloved fingers. Red blood-stained tissue and a surgical incision edge appear to the left of the mass, and a yellow-orange stained skin area lies below it. The field is covered by green surgical drapes with a white drape at the top, and a surgical instrument is visible near the upper left. Gloved hands enter from the left and lower right. No text, panel letters or scale are visible.
